dashboard.title: Nutrition & Wallet Dashboard
dashboard.hubDescription: Manage school meal plans, menus, meal consumption, and student pocket money accounts.
dashboard.enhancementNote: Dashboard enhanced with key stats, charts, and quick links.

mealPlans.title: Meal Plans Management
mealPlans.description: Define and manage meal plans offered by the school.
mealPlans.deleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete this meal plan?

menus.title: Daily/Weekly Menus Management
menus.description: Create and manage menus for different meal types on specific dates.
menus.descriptionPlaceholder: e.g., Rice, Beef Stew, Cabbage, and a Banana
menus.deleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete this menu? This might affect consumption logs.

studentMealAssignments.title: Student Meal Plan Assignments
studentMealAssignments.noPeriodSelectedMessage: Please select a school period to view and manage assignments.
studentMealAssignments.alertStudentAlreadyActive: This student already has an active meal plan for this period. Please edit the existing assignment or set it to inactive first.

mealConsumption.title: Log Meal Consumption
mealConsumption.description: Select a student and the meal they are consuming. The system will check their meal plan or deduct from their wallet if applicable.
mealConsumption.noMenuFound: No menu found for the selected date and meal type. Please define it first.
mealConsumption.noLogsMessage: No meal consumption logs recorded yet.

merchants.title: Merchants Management (e.g., Canteen)
merchants.description: Define merchants where students can make purchases using their wallets. Link to a revenue GL account.
merchants.deleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete this merchant?

studentWallet.title: Student Wallet Management
studentWallet.searchPlaceholder: Search by student name or admission no...
studentWallet.noTransactionsMessage: No transactions found for this student.
